blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/
blocks.zh: 将现有的漫画改编成始终忠于源头的连贯动画,是一项宝贵而具有挑战性的任务。 现有方法要么主要通过文字来访问漫画,失去其人物和艺术风格,要么直接将漫画页输入视频生成模型,这曲解了漫画的结构并产生了不正确的故事情节. 在本文中,我们提出"曼加2Animate",即一个多代理框架,将每个世代阶段都以源头曼加为基础. 我们把任务分解为两个中间代表,一个动画剧本和一个视觉故事板. 每一份陈述均由创作代理制作,并由一对编审代理对源面板进行审查。 我们在综合最后动画之前,将特定代表的选择和双重反馈加以调整,以逐步完善两者。 广泛的实验和用户研究表明,"曼加2"(Manga2Animate)制作的动画更忠实于出自"出自"漫画"(source manga),并比最先进的方法更一致地拍摄出相片. 项目网页:https://annchen.github.io/Manga2Animate/

blocks.en: Manga is one of the richest sources of stories for animation. Popular titles are routinely adapted into anime, and fans expect these adaptations to move smoothly and tell the story coherently while remaining faithful to the characters and art style they love. Yet producing such an adaptation remains slow and costly, often taking large teams of artists months of storyboarding, key animation, in-betweening, and coloring.
blocks.zh: 漫画是动画故事最丰富的来源之一. 流行的头衔通常被改编成动画,粉丝们期望这些改编能顺利地进行,并连贯地讲述故事,同时忠于自己所喜爱的角色和艺术风格. 然而,制作这种改编仍然缓慢,费用高昂,往往需要大批艺术家数月的时间进行故事板刻、关键动画、介于中间和着色。

blocks.en: At the same time, a manga already specifies much of what an animation needs, including who the characters are and what they look like, how each shot is framed, and how the plot unfolds. With recent advances in video generation, it is natural to ask whether a manga can be brought to life automatically. However, as Fig. 2 shows, storytelling systems that first describe the manga in words discard its visual appearance, so the original art style is lost ( 1 ) and characters change appearance or drift between anime and photorealistic styles ( 2 ). Feeding manga pages directly into a video model fails for a different reason. The model knows neither the order in which the panels should be read nor what speech balloons mean, so it tells the wrong story ( 3 ) or even places manga panels, or entire pages, directly into the video as frames ( 4 ).
blocks.zh: 同时,一幅漫画已经详细说明了动画需要的很多内容,包括人物是谁和他们长什么样子,每个镜头是如何设定的,以及情节是如何展开的. 随着视频生成的近期进步,自然会问漫画能否自动复活. 然而,如图2所示,首先在文字中描述漫画的故事系统抛弃了它的视觉外观,因此原艺术风格丢失(1),人物改变外观或漂移在动画风格和摄影现实主义风格之间(2). 将漫画页面直接输入视频模型失败的原因不同. 模型既不了解面板应读的顺序,也不了解语音气球的意思,因此它讲述了错误的故事(3),甚至将漫画面板,或整页直接放入视频中作为帧(4).

blocks.en: Our key observation is that today’s video generation models already know how to animate. What they cannot do is understand a manga. Given a manga page, they produce smooth and appealing motion, yet they follow the panels in the wrong order and misread the speech balloons, so the result looks convincing but tells a completely wrong story (Fig. 2 b). We therefore do not replace these models. Instead, we keep their rich visual knowledge and give them what they are missing, a clear understanding of the manga. Much like an animation studio, Manga2Animate (Fig. 1 ) first turns the manga into an animation script, which describes what happens in each panel, and a storyboard, which shows how each shot should look. Both are built by AI agents and checked against the original panels, so the video model receives a faithful plan instead of raw manga pages. We find that this plan effectively constrains generation. With the script fixing the plot and the storyboard fixing the characters, composition, and art style, the video model no longer has to interpret the manga on its own and can focus on what it does best, bringing the story to life.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要观察是,今天的视频生成模型已经知道如何激活。 他们不能做的就是理解漫画 由于漫画的一页,他们产生平滑和有吸引力的动作,然而他们却按照错误的顺序跟随面板,误读了演讲气球,因此结果看起来令人信服,却讲述了一个完全错误的故事(图2b). 因此,我们不取代这些模式。 相反,我们保留着他们丰富的视觉知识,给他们他们所缺少的东西,一个对漫画的明确理解. 和动画工作室一样,Manga2Animate(图1)首先将动画改编成动画剧本,其中描述了每个面板中发生的事情,以及一个故事板,显示每个镜头应该如何外观. 两者都由AI代理制造,并与原版面板对照检查,因此视频模型接收到一个忠实的计划,而不是原始的漫畫頁面. 我们认为,这一计划有效地限制了发电。 随着剧本修饰情节和故事板修饰角色,组成,艺术风格,视频模型不再需要自己来诠释漫画,而可以专注于自己最擅长的事,让故事生机勃勃.

blocks.en: Experiments show that Manga2Animate produces animations that are more faithful to the original characters, art style, and plot than existing storytelling and video generation methods, even when these methods are given the same script as ours. Because our framework guides existing models rather than replacing them, it works with both open-source and commercial image and video generators, and outperforms prior methods with either. In a user study, participants selected our results as the best overall in over 90% of responses, for both storyboards and videos.
blocks.zh: 实验显示,Manga2Animate制作的动画比现有的讲故事和视频生成方法更忠实于原创人物,艺术风格,情节,即使这些方法被赋予与我们相同的剧本. 因为我们的框架指导了现有的模型,而不是替代它们,它与开源和商业图像和视频生成器同时工作,并且比以前的方法都好。 在一项用户研究中,参与者选择了我们的结果作为超过90%的答复中最好的,无论是故事板还是视频。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: • We present Manga2Animate, to the best of our knowledge the first automated framework that turns existing manga into animation that is faithful to source manga. • We show that planning through a script and a storyboard, iteratively refined with dual-level feedback from both and verified against the original manga, is key to preserving the characters, art style, and plot. • We establish an evaluation protocol for manga-to-animation generation, under which Manga2Animate outperforms existing methods, and we further validate these results with a user study.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献有三个方面: 我们介绍Manga2Animate, 据我们所知,这是第一个自动框架,它将现有的Manga转化为忠实于源漫画的动画。 我们通过一个脚本和一个故事板进行规划,经过反复的改进,从两个方面得到双重的反馈,并对照原漫画加以核实,这是保存人物、艺术风格和情节的关键。 我们为人造人与活化人建立了评估协议,根据该协议,Manga2Animate超越了现有方法,我们通过用户研究进一步验证这些结果.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Built on annotated corpora ( Matsui et al., 2017 ; Aizawa et al., 2020 ; Vivoli et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2024a ) , manga understanding has progressed from detecting panels, characters, and text ( Shen et al., 2023 ) to ordering panels and attributing dialogue ( Sachdeva & Zisserman, 2024 ) , naming characters across chapters ( Sachdeva et al., 2024 ) , and narrating chapters as prose ( Sachdeva & Zisserman, 2025 ) . Vision-language models are now benchmarked on manga ( Baek et al., 2026 ; Ikuta et al., 2025 ; Vivoli et al., 2025 ) , yet still misread cross-panel narrative ( Baranwal et al., 2025 ) and can rely on memorized popular content rather than visual evidence ( Szu-Tu et al., 2025 ) ; generation from comics remains largely unexplored ( Vivoli et al., 2024b ) . We use Sachdeva & Zisserman (2024) for pre-processing and, given this fragility, review every intermediate output against the source panels.
blocks.zh: 建于注解的蝎子座上 (Matsui等人,2017年;Aizawa等人,2020年;Vivoli等人,2024年a;Li等人,2024年a),漫画理解从探测面板,人物和文字(Shen等人,2023年)发展到订购面板和归属对话(Sachdeva & Zisserman,2024年),将人物命名于各章(Sachdeva等人,2024年),并将章节描述为散文(Sachdeva & Zisserman,2025年). 愿景语言模型现在以漫画为基准(Baek等人,2026年;Ikuta等人,2025年;Vivoli等人,2025年),然而仍然误读跨小组的叙事(Baranwal等人,2025年),可以依赖被记住的流行内容而不是视觉证据(Szu-Tu等人,2025年);漫画中的一代仍然基本上没有得到探讨(Vivoli等人,2024年b). 我们使用Sachdeva & Zisserman(2024年)进行预处理,并鉴于这种脆弱性,对照源面板审查每一个中间输出.

blocks.en: Story visualization renders a narrative as a consistent image sequence, evolving from GANs ( Li et al., 2019 ) to diffusion models with visual memory ( Rahman et al., 2023 ) , identity conditioning ( Ye et al., 2023 ) , shared attention ( Tewel et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , frame context ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , multi-subject personalization ( He et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025b ) , iterative refinement ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , and language-model layout planning ( He et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) , with dedicated benchmarks ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) and extensions to manga generation ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . These methods generate from text, whereas our storyboard is conditioned on and selected against the manga panels.
blocks.zh: 故事可视化使叙事成为一致的图像序列,从GANs(Li等人,2019年)演化为具有视觉记忆的传播模型(Rahman等人,2023年),身份调节(Ye等人,2023年),共同关注(Tewel等人,2024年;周等人,2024年),帧背景(Liu等人,2024年a年),多主题个性化. (He等人,2025b;Wang等人,2025b;Wu等人,2025b),迭代完善(Mao等人,2026年),语言模式布局规划(He等人,2025a; Wang et al.,2025a; Cheng et al.,2024),有专用基准( Zhu等,2026年;Gao et al.,2025年),并延伸至漫画一代(Wu et al.,2025a;Wang et al.,2026a). 这些方法来自文字,而我们的故事板则在壁画面板上设条件和选择。

blocks.en: Video diffusion has advanced from short clips ( Ho et al., 2022 ) to foundation models ( Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ) , whose adherence to explicit specifications is now benchmarked ( Huang et al., 2026d ) . Cross-shot consistency is pursued through long-context tuning ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) , keyframe memory ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , storyboard anchoring ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and reference-based identity injection ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . For animation, anime-oriented models and datasets ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ) and in-betweening and colorization methods ( Xing et al., 2024 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Tang et al., 2025 ) create motion and color from sparse inputs. We use such models as interchangeable backends and, in the spirit of decoupling explicit state from generative rendering ( Huang et al., 2026c ) , obtain consistency from the reviewed script and storyboard rather than from architecture (Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 视频传播已经从短片(Ho等人,2022年)发展到基础模型(Kong等人,2024年;Wan等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年;Polyak等人,2024年;Seedance等人,2026年),他们遵守明确规格的情况现已确定基准(Huang等人,2026年d). 通过长文调试(郭等,2025年;萧等,2026年;孟等,2026年),关键框架记忆(张等,2025年a;周等,2026年),故事板锚定(张等,2026年),以及参考身份注射(江等,2025年;刘等,2025年a;胡等,2025年),追求跨镜头一致性. 就动画而言,面向动画的模型和数据集(Jiang等人,2024年;Quu等人,2025年)以及介于动画和色化方法之间(Xing等人,2024年;Meng等人,2025年;Huang等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年b;Tang等人,2025年)从稀疏的投入创造运动和色彩. 我们使用可互换的后端等模型,并本着将显性状态与基因渲染脱钩的精神(Huang等人,2026c),从被审阅的脚本和故事板而不是从架构中取得一致性(Sec 4.4)。

blocks.en: Language and vision-language agents increasingly orchestrate video production from script to storyboard, clips, and assembly ( Lin et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025c ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2026b ) , some with critics that select clips by tree search ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , gate anime production stages ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Yan et al., 2026 ) , or self-improve at test time ( Long et al., 2026 ) , following self-feedback in language agents ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) , a pattern also adopted to verify generated images and figures ( Huang et al., 2026a ; Tseng et al., 2026 ) . Our creator–reviewer design is closest to these systems, but they invent characters, shots, and plot from a prompt and can only check outputs against their own script, whereas our reviewers check against the manga panels. Earlier manga-to-animation systems only moved a virtual camera over panels or added synthesized speech ( Cao et al., 2016 ; Gupta et al., 2021 ) ; to our knowledge, ours is the first to generate faithful multi-shot animation from manga pages.
blocks.zh: 语言和视觉语言代理人越来越多地协调从剧本到故事板、剪辑和组装的录像制作(Lin等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年b;徐等人,2025年a); Wu等人,2025c; Hu等人,2024年;徐等人,2025年b;Wang等人,2026年b;Huang等人,2026年b),有的有批评家通过树搜索选择剪辑(Shi等人,2025年),门动漫生产阶段(张等人,2025年b; Yan et al., 2026 ),或测试时自我改进(Long et al., 2026 ),跟随语言剂的自食其力(Madaan et al., 2023; Shinn et al., 2023 ),也采用了一种模式来验证生成的图像和数字(Huang et al., 2026a;Tseng et al., 2026). 我们的创造者-审查者设计最接近于这些系统,但他们从一个瞬间发明了人物、镜头和图案,并且只能对照自己的脚本检查产出,而我们的审查者则对照漫画板检查。 早期的manga-to-animation系统只将虚拟相机移动过面板或添加合成语音(Cao et al.,2016;Gupta et al.,2021);据我们所知,我们的是第一个从manga页面生成忠实的多镜头动画.

(b) Creator and reviewer agents refine an animation script and a visual storyboard over N N rounds and select the best script and best storyboard, dual-level feedback also guides the next round. blocks.en: 3.1 Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 制定任务

blocks.en: Given a set of manga pages M = { m 1 , … , m p } M=\{m_{1},\ldots,m_{p}\} in their original reading order, our goal is to generate a coherent animated video V V . Each manga page consists of multiple manga panels , where a panel is an individual visual frame depicting a particular moment, action, or scene. From the input pages, we obtain an ordered sequence of N p N_{p} target manga panels P = { p 1 , … , p N p } P=\{p_{1},\ldots,p_{N_{p}}\} ( N p = 6 N_{p}=6 in our experiments) and a transcript T T . For prominent characters appearing in the selected manga panels, we additionally use character reference images R R . These references are taken from official color artwork when available; otherwise, clear appearances of the characters are cropped from the input manga.
blocks.zh: 考虑到一套漫畫頁面 M = { m 1,..., m  p m_{ m_{ 1},\ ldots, m_{p}\} 依其原读序,我们的目标是生成一个连贯的动画视频V V. 每个壁画页由多个壁画面板组成,其中一个面板是一个单独的视觉框架,描绘特定的时刻,动作,或场景. 从输入页中,我们获得一个命令序列N p N_{p}目标漫画板 P = {p 1,..., p N p} P=\{p_{1},\ldots,p_{n_{p}}\}(我们的实验中N p = 6 N_{p}=6)和笔录T T. 对于出现在选定漫画面板中的显著字符,我们额外使用字符参考图像R R. 这些参考文献来自官方的彩色艺术品(如果有的话);否则,这些字符的清晰外观会从输入漫画中裁剪出来。

blocks.en: Our pipeline transforms these inputs through two intermediate representations: an animation script S = { s 1 , … , s N p } S=\{s_{1},\ldots,s_{N_{p}}\} and a visual storyboard B = { b 1 , … , b N p } B=\{b_{1},\ldots,b_{N_{p}}\} , before producing the final video V V , as illustrated in Fig. 3 . We also derive per-character descriptions D D from the reference images R R .

blocks.en: The use of S S and B B is inspired by real-world animation production workflows, where the narrative is first organized into a script and subsequently translated into a storyboard before animation is produced. Following this workflow, S S serves as the textual specification of the animation. Each script clip s i s_{i} describes the content corresponding to manga panel p i p_{i} , including the scene, camera, character positions and actions, expressions, and dialogue. The storyboard B B then converts this textual specification into a visual plan, where each storyboard panel b i b_{i} specifies the appearance and scene composition of the corresponding animated clip.

blocks.en: Throughout the pipeline, we maintain an explicit correspondence between the source manga and the generated representations as illustrated in Fig. A1 : manga panel p i p_{i} , script clip s i s_{i} , and storyboard panel b i b_{i} all describe the same narrative unit. This alignment allows each generated component to be directly traced back to its source manga panel during review and refinement.
blocks.zh: 在整个编审过程中,我们保持源头漫画与法格所示产生的表述之间的明确通信。 A1:漫画面板p i p_{i},脚本剪辑s i s_{i},和故事板面板b i b_{i}都描述了相同的叙事单位. 这种调整使每个生成的组件能够在审查和完善时直接追溯到其源头漫画板。

blocks.en: 3.2 Agents
blocks.zh: 3.2 代理人

blocks.en: Manga2Animate uses two types of agents at each stage of the pipeline (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: Manga2Animate在管道的每个阶段都使用两种制剂(图3).

blocks.en: Creators. A creator takes the inputs of its stage and produces the intermediate output of that stage.
blocks.zh: 造物师. 创作者接受其阶段的投入,产生该阶段的中间输出.

blocks.en: Reviewers. A reviewer reviews the outputs of its creator, selects the best one, and gives feedback for refinement. Full review criteria and prompts are listed in Appendices G and H .
blocks.zh: 审者. 评审员审查创作者的产出,选择最佳产出,并反馈完善. 附录G和H列出了全面审查标准和提示。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Compositional (clip-wise) selection by the Script Reviewer. The reviewer selects the best character and clip description at each panel position across the N s N_{s} candidate scripts and reassembles them into one best script (left). For one panel (right), it flags inaccurate details (red) in two candidates and selects the one matching the panel (green).
blocks.zh: 图4:脚本审查者对组成(clip-with)的选择. 评论员在Ns NQQS}候选脚本的每个面板位置选择最佳字符和剪辑描述,并将其重新组合成一个最佳脚本(左). 对于一个面板(右),它标记两个候选人的不准确细节(红色),并选择一个匹配面板(绿色).

blocks.en: 3.3 Pre-processing
blocks.zh: 3.3 预处理

blocks.en: Manga pages often exhibit non-trivial panel layouts, making reading order an important prerequisite for preserving the narrative flow. We therefore detect the panels on each page and determine their reading order using a manga-specific detection model and its associated ordering algorithm ( Sachdeva & Zisserman, 2024 ) . The resulting ordered panel sequence is then passed to the subsequent stages of the pipeline. In parallel, the same model also detects and transcribes the text on these pages, which we merge into a single transcript spanning all pages to help the Script Creator write each panel’s dialogue and plot (Sec. 3.4 ). Also, we use a Character Description Creator to establish a consistent representation of each character from the reference image R R . It extracts relatively stable, identity-defining traits, such as facial features and body build, while excluding variable attributes such as clothing and accessories. These character descriptions are then provided to the downstream Script and Storyboard Creators to help maintain character consistency throughout the generation process.
blocks.zh: 漫威版面经常表现出非三角面板布局,使阅读顺序成为保留叙事流的重要前提. 因此,我们检测每一页的面板,并使用漫画专用的检测模型及其相关的订购算法(Sachdeva & Zisserman, 2024)确定其读取顺序。 随后,所订购的面板序列被传递到输油管的后几个阶段。 同时,同一模型也检测和转录这些页面上的文本,我们把这些文本合并成一份覆盖所有页面的单一记录稿,以帮助脚本创建者编写每个面板的对话和情节(第3.4节)。 另外,我们使用一个字符描述创建器,从参考图像R R 建立每个字符的一致表示. 它提取出相对稳定,身份界定的特征,如面部特征和身体构造,同时排除服装和配件等可变属性. 这些字符描述随后提供给下游的脚本和故事板创建者,以帮助在整个生成过程中保持字符的一致性.

blocks.en: 3.4 Script and Storyboard Refinement
blocks.zh: 3.4 脚本和故事板

blocks.en: To improve generation reliability while controlling API costs, we combine a small number of candidates per stage with iterative refinement, in which reviewer feedback guides the next round of generation. We run N = 2 N=2 refinement rounds: the first round explores initial candidates, and the second round revises them using the first-round feedback.
blocks.zh: 为了在控制API成本的同时提高生成可靠性,我们将每个阶段的少量候选人与迭代完善结合起来,其中审查者反馈指导下一代. 我们运行N = 2 N = 2改进回合:第一轮探索初选者,第二轮利用第一轮反馈进行修改.

blocks.en: In each refinement round, the Script Creator generates N s N_{s} script candidates ( N s = 3 N_{s}=3 ) conditioned on the manga panels, character descriptions, transcript, and, from the second round onward, the feedback from the previous round. Errors in scripts are largely local, a candidate may describe one panel precisely yet misread another, and different candidates tend to make different mistakes. Selecting a single script as a whole would discard the correct descriptions contained in the other candidates. The Script Reviewer therefore performs compositional selection at the clip level (Fig. 4 ), preserving complementary strengths across candidates, and records the remaining weaknesses of each selected component as feedback for the next round.
blocks.zh: 在每轮完善中,脚本创建者都会生成Ns N_{s}脚本候选人(Ns = 3 N_{s}=s}=3),以漫画面板,人物描述,笔录为条件,从第二轮开始,从上一轮的反馈. 脚本错误主要是局部的,候选人可能描述一个小组准确却错误解读另一个小组,不同的候选人往往会犯不同的错误. 整体上选择一个单一的脚本将放弃其他候选人所载的正确说明。 因此,脚本审查员在剪辑一级(图4)进行组成选择,保持候选人之间的互补优势,并将每个选定组成部分的其余弱点记录为下一轮的反馈。

blocks.en: The Storyboard Creator then generates N b N_{b} storyboard candidates ( N b = 3 N_{b}=3 ) for the selected script. Unlike scripts, closed-source storyboards are selected as a complete image because their panels are generated jointly and share style, color, and lighting; recombining panels across candidates could introduce visual inconsistencies. The Storyboard Reviewer compares candidates pairwise in the first round and, in later rounds, compares each new candidate with the previous best, judging each storyboard against the script that produced it. If no new candidate wins, the previous best storyboard is retained with its script and feedback, keeping the final pair consistent. The open-source backend instead generates and selects panels individually before compositing them due to its constraints (more details in Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 故事板创建者随后为所选的剧本生成Nb NQQB}故事板候选人(Nb = 3 NQQBX 3). 与脚本不同的是,闭源故事板被选为一个完整的图像,因为它们的面板是联合生成的,并共享风格,颜色,以及照明;跨候选人的重新组合面板可以引入视觉不一致. "故事板评论员"在第一轮中将候选人进行对等比较,在后一轮中,将每个新候选人与之前的最佳人选进行比较,判断每个故事板与制作剧本相对应. 如果没有新的候选者获胜,则保留之前最好的故事板及其脚本和反馈,保持最终对战一致. 开源后端则会因受限制而在堆肥面板之前分别生成和选择面板(详见附录B).

blocks.en: Script-level and storyboard-level feedback are jointly provided to the next-round Script Creator, together with the best script from the previous round and the source manga panels. This dual-level feedback allows the pipeline to refine the textual specification using evidence from its visual realization. Issues flagged by the Storyboard Reviewer are treated as symptoms of ambiguous or inaccurate script descriptions: the Script Creator is instructed to identify the responsible part of the script, such as an ambiguous spatial description or a missing detail. To prevent unnecessary changes to already correct content, the Script Creator revises only the script clips or character descriptions explicitly identified as problematic by the reviewers, while leaving all other entries unchanged. When feedback from different reviewers conflicts, the corresponding source manga panel is used as the primary reference for deciding the revision. The script and storyboard selected in the final round are then passed to the video-generation stage.
blocks.zh: 脚本级别和故事板级别反馈联合提供给下一轮脚本创建者,同时提供上一轮最佳脚本和源漫画面板. 这种双层反馈使得管道能够利用其视觉实现中的证据来完善文字规格. "故事板"评论员标出的问题被作为文字描述模棱两可或不准确的症状处理:脚本创建者被指示识别脚本中的责任部分,如一个模棱两可的空间描述或一个缺失的细节. 为防止不必要的更改以达到已经正确的内容,脚本创建者只修改被审查者明确认定为有问题的脚本片段或字符描述,同时保留所有其他条目不变. 当来自不同审查者的反馈出现冲突时,相应的源漫画面板被用作决定修订的主要参考. 最终回合中选择的剧本和故事板随后传递到视频生成阶段.

blocks.en: 3.5 Video Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.5 视频生成 管道

blocks.en: To accommodate different input formats of video generation models, our video generation pipeline supports two modes: a first-frame mode and a reference-conditioned mode. The former is used for models that take a single image as the first frame, while the latter is used for models that can take the complete storyboard as a reference and generate a multi-shot video at once. Our main experimental results use the reference-conditioned mode.
blocks.zh: 为了适应视频生成模型的不同输入格式,我们的视频生成管道支持两种模式:第一帧模式和参考条件模式. 前者用于以单一图像为第一帧的模型,后者用于可以将完整的故事板作为参考,同时生成多镜头视频的模型. 我们的主要实验结果采用参照条件模式.

blocks.en: In first-frame mode, each storyboard panel serves as the first frame of its corresponding clip. For each clip, the Video Creator generates N v N_{v} candidates ( N v = 2 N_{v}=2 ) conditioned on that panel and its script description, and the Video Reviewer selects the better one using the script, panel, and previously selected clip when available. This greedy and clip-by-clip process enforces cross-clip continuity at selection time, after which the selected clips are concatenated in story order. In reference-conditioned mode, the Video Creator instead uses the complete best script and full storyboard to generate N v N_{v} complete multi-shot candidates in one pass, from which the Video Reviewer selects the final result.
blocks.zh: 在第一帧模式中,每个故事板面板作为其相应剪辑的第一帧. 对于每个片段,视频创建者以该片面板及其脚本描述为条件生成N v N_{v}候选人(N v = 2 N_{v}=2),视频评论员会选择使用脚本,面板的更好的片段,并在有可用时选择之前选定的片段. 这种贪婪和切片逐剪的过程在选择时间执行交叉切片的连续性,之后所选择的剪辑按照故事顺序进行调整. 在参考条件模式下,视频创建者转而使用完整的最佳脚本和完整的故事板在一张通行证中生成N v N_{v}完整的多镜头候选人,视频评论员从中选择最终结果.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: Our evaluation set contains eight stories of six ordered manga panels, drawn from Manga109 ( Matsui et al., 2017 ; Aizawa et al., 2020 ) and additional cases covering diverse backgrounds, characters, interactions, and actions. All methods use the same stories, enabling evaluation of both panel-level fidelity and cross-clip consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价集包含了来自Manga109(松井等人,2017年;爱泽等人,2020年)的6个订购漫画板的8个故事,以及涵盖不同背景、人物、互动和行动的其他案例。 所有方法都使用相同的故事,使得能够评价面板的忠诚度和交叉剪切的一致性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线

blocks.en: We use StoryDiffusion ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , Story-Iter ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , and AnyStory ( He et al., 2025b ) as storyboard-generation baselines, and AniMaker ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , ViMax ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , and StoryMem ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) as video-generation baselines. We further compare with direct manga-to-video generation by feeding the manga pages directly into Seedance 2.0 or MiniMax-H3. To compare generation ability rather than manga understanding, every script-based baseline receives the same refined script as Manga2Animate. We also provide the same manga character reference images whenever the baseline accepts reference images. Full adaptation details are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们以"故事传播"(周永康等,2024年),"故事时代"(毛泽东等,2026年),"AnyStory"(他等,2025年b)为故事板生成基线,以"AniMaker"(史等,2025年b),"ViMax"(黄等,2026年b),"故事记忆"(张等,2025年a)为视频生成基线. 我们通过将漫画页直接输入种子2.0或MiniMax-H3,与直接的漫画到视频生成进行进一步比较。 为了比较生成能力而不是漫画理解,每个基于脚本的基线都得到与Manga2Animate相同的精细脚本. 我们还在基线接受参考图像时提供同样的漫画字符参考图像。 完整的修改细节见附录E。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价计量

blocks.en: MangaEval adapts existing metrics to the manga input and multi-shot output, evaluating storyboard Visual Consistency, Content Alignment, Aesthetic Quality, and Cost, as well as video Manga Alignment, Video Quality, Aesthetic Quality, and Cost. Full definitions and objectives are in Appendix F (Tabs. A7 and A7 ).
blocks.zh: MangaEval根据漫画的输入和多镜头输出调整了现有的衡量标准,评价故事板的视觉一致性,内容一致性,审美质量,和成本,以及视频Manga对齐,视频质量,审美质量,和成本. 完整的定义和目标载于附录F(A7和A7)。

blocks.en: At the video level, we evaluate I2V Subject (I2VS), I2V Background (I2VB), Subject Consistency (SC), Background Consistency (BC), Motion Smoothness (MS), and Dynamic Degree (DD) segment by segment against the source panels. We replace VBench++’s ( Huang et al., 2025 ) DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) with DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) for I2VS and its binary DD with a continuous motion-magnitude score; aesthetics are evaluated on sampled frames with two anime-specific models.
blocks.zh: 在视频层面,我们对照源面板逐段评价I2V主题(I2VS),I2V背景(I2VB),主题一致性(SC),背景一致性(BC),运动平滑性(MS)和动态度(DD)部分. 我们用DINov3(Siméoni等人,2025年)取代V Bench++’s(黄.等人,2025年)DINO(Caron等人,2021年),用于I2VS及其二进制DD,并具有连续的运动放大分数;美学用两个动量特异性模型在样品框上进行评估.

blocks.en: Detailed storyboard evaluation metrics are provided in Appendix F (Table A7 ).
blocks.zh: 详细的故事板评价指标见附录F(表A7)。

blocks.zh: 4.4 定量比较

For a fair comparison with ViMax, both methods use the same script, image model, and video model. Our FLUX.2 + MiniMax-H3 setting also performs well, showing that the improvement is not tied to one model combination. blocks.en: Overall, Table 1 shows that our pipeline better preserves the manga content and keeps the video clips visually consistent. The improvement remains when we change the image or video model, suggesting that it comes from the script, storyboard, and review process rather than one specific model. DD only measures how much movement a video contains, so a higher DD does not mean that the movement is correct. Storyboard results are reported in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 总的来说,表1显示,我们的管道更好地保存漫画内容,并保持视频片段在视觉上的一致性。 当我们改变图像或视频模型时,改进仍然存在,暗示它来自剧本、故事板和审查过程,而不是一个特定的模型。 DD只衡量视频包含的移动量,所以较高的DD并不意味着该移动是正确的. 故事板的结果载于附录C。

blocks.en: 4.7 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.7 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate the three stage-specific reviewers, compare clip-wise with whole-script selection, remove each level of feedback, ablate the refinement loop and storyboard generation, and evaluate video generation mode, using the main configuration as reference.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了三个阶段特定审查员,将剪辑与整段标注选择进行对比,去掉每个层次的反馈,减少完善的循环和故事板生成,评价视频生成模式,以主配置作为参考.

blocks.en: Table 2: Effect of removing each stage-specific reviewer. When a reviewer is removed, that stage generates only one candidate and receives no review or feedback; all other settings stay the same. Removing any reviewer lowers the overall alignment and consistency scores. Removing the Script Reviewer causes the largest drop in I2VS. Some variants score higher on MS or Shadow-v2, but score lower on alignment, consistency, or DD. Red and orange mark the best and second-best results; higher is better.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework for faithfully adapting existing manga into coherent multi-shot animation. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations grounded in the source manga, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Creator and reviewer agents iteratively generate, review, and refine both. Since the two representations fail in different ways, we compose scripts clip by clip, select storyboards as a whole, and feed storyboard-level issues back to the script. Under MangaEval, an evaluation protocol adapted from ViStoryBench and VBench++, Manga2Animate outperforms state-of-the-art storyboard and video generation methods on manga-fidelity and consistency metrics, even when baselines receive the same refined script and character references, and is strongly preferred in a user study. Promising future directions include improving robustness to complex or roughly sketched art styles, developing source-grounded evaluation of story events, and extending narrative understanding across pages and chapters.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Manga2Animate,这是忠实地将现有漫画改编成连贯的多镜头动画的多代理框架. 我们把任务分解成两个基于源漫画的中间代表,一个动画剧本和一个视觉故事板. 创建者和审查者代理人迭代生成、审查和完善两者。 由于两种表现方式不同而失败,我们按剪辑来编剧本片段,整体上选择故事板,并将故事板层次的问题反馈到剧本中. 在MangaEval下,根据ViStory Bench和V Bench++改编的评价协议,Manga2Animate在manga-fility和一致性度量标准上超越了最先进的故事板和视频生成方法,即使基线得到相同的精细脚本和字符引用,在用户研究中也非常受欢迎. 未来有希望的方向包括改进对复杂或粗略描绘的艺术风格的稳健性,对故事事件进行基于源头的评价,以及将叙事理解扩展到各页和各章.

blocks.en: Our method has several limitations. First, as an agentic pipeline built on stochastic generative models, its outputs may vary across runs. Second, API-based models may restrict generation of copyrighted or policy-sensitive content. Finally, when the source manga is highly sketchy, cluttered, or compositionally complex, or a scene requires context from elsewhere in the story, the pipeline may misinterpret panel content.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法有几个局限性。 首先,作为建立在有条理的基因模型上的代理管道,其产出可能各不相同。 其次,基于API的模式可能会限制版权或政策敏感内容的生成. 最后,当源头漫画高度粗略,杂乱,或组成复杂,或一个场景需要故事中其他地方的背景时,管道可能会曲解面板内容.

blocks.en: Appendix B Open-Source Storyboard Backend
blocks.zh: 附录 B 开源故事板后端

blocks.en: In our experiments, the open-source image model we tested (FLUX.2-dev) did not reliably generate a complete, high-quality multi-panel storyboard in a single pass. We therefore adopt a panel-wise generation strategy, producing multiple candidates for each panel and selecting the best one before composing the final storyboard. For each panel in the selected script, we construct a prompt that incorporates the character descriptions, the corresponding script content, and constraints derived from the original manga panel to preserve its composition, camera viewpoint, and character pose. When character reference crops are available, they are explicitly associated with the corresponding characters during generation.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们测试的开源图像模型(FLUX.2-dev)未能可靠地在一次传球中产生完整,高质量的多板故事板. 因此,我们采取一个基于小组的生成战略,为每个小组产生多个候选人,并在组成最后的故事板之前选择最佳人选。 对于所选脚本中的每个面板,我们构建一个包含字符描述,对应脚本内容,以及原漫画面板产生的限制的提示,以保留其组成,相机视角,和人物姿势. 当存在字符参考作物时,它们会在生成时与相应的字符明确相关.

blocks.en: FLUX.2-dev is conditioned on the source manga panel and the available character references to generate multiple candidates for each panel. A Gemini-based reviewer then scores each candidate independently on manga/script follow (the primary criterion), character identity consistency, art style and colorization quality, and background fidelity, each on a 0–4 scale, and the highest-scoring candidate is retained. The selected panels are then assembled into a 3 × 2 3\times 2 storyboard grid, following the same output format as the closed-source backend to enable evaluation under a unified protocol. Since every panel is conditioned on its source manga panel and the shared character references, these common conditions help maintain cross-panel consistency.
blocks.zh: FLUX.2-dev以源漫画面板和现有的字符引用为条件,为每个面板产生多个候选人. 双子座式审查员然后根据漫画/标语对每个候选人进行独立评分(首要标准),人物身份一致性,艺术风格和色彩化质量,背景忠诚度,每名候选人按0-4级评分,最高评分的候选人保留. 然后将选定的面板组装成3×2 3\times 2故事板网格,遵循与闭源后端相同的输出格式,以便在统一协议下进行评价. 由于每个面板都以它的源漫画面板和共享字符引用为条件,这些共同的条件有助于保持跨面板的一致性.

blocks.en: Appendix C Storyboard Quantitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录 C 故事板 定量评价

blocks.en: We evaluate storyboards with CSD, CIDS, PA, and OCCM from ViStoryBench ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , adapting three of them to manga: CIDS uses SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) instead of CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) for finer character-crop detail, OCCM’s expected character count comes from the source manga panel rather than the script’s cast list, and PA is judged by GPT-4.1 instead of Gemini (our pipeline’s reviewer) to reduce self-preference bias. Since all script-conditioned methods share the same refined script, PA measures content adherence under an identical specification, while CSD, CIDS, and OCCM (and the Manga Plot criterion of our user study) capture fidelity to the source manga itself; full definitions are in Appendix F . For Aesthetic Quality, we replace ViStoryBench’s general-purpose predictor with two anime-specific models, Aesthetic Shadow v2 1 1 1 Released by shadowlilac as shadowlilac/aesthetic-shadow-v2, which is no longer available; we use the community mirror at https://huggingface.co/NeoChen1024/aesthetic-shadow-v2-backup . and Waifu-v3 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/Eugeoter/waifu-scorer-v3 , trained on anime/illustration imagery and used for training-data curation in production anime models.

blocks.en: Table A1 compares storyboard generation across methods. The two Manga2Animate configurations jointly achieve the best results on all four manga-fidelity metrics: the open-source FLUX.2 backend reaches the highest CSD and OCCM, while the closed-source Gemini backend achieves the highest CIDS and PA, each improving over the best baseline. Since all baselines use the same refined script as our method, the PA gap reflects content adherence under an identical specification, and this advantage holds for both an open and a closed image backend rather than relying on a specific image model.
blocks.zh: 表A1比较了不同方法的故事板生成. 两个Manga2Animate配置在所有四个manga-firity度量衡上共同取得最佳效果:开源FLUX.2后端达到最高的CSD和OCCM,而闭源双子午后端则达到最高的CIDS和PA,每个后端都比最佳基线有所改善. 由于所有基线都使用与我们的方法相同的精细脚本,所以PA差距在相同的规格下反映了内容的坚持性,而这种优势既对一个开放的和封闭的图像后端,又不依赖特定的图像模型.

blocks.en: In contrast, StoryDiffusion and Story-Iter score higher on the anime-specific aesthetic metrics but considerably lower on manga fidelity (CIDS, PA, OCCM), since both freely generate imagery from text without being constrained by the original characters and composition. This indicates that single-image aesthetics and adaptation fidelity are distinct aspects: an aesthetic predictor assesses the appeal of an individual illustration without considering whether it is consistent with the source. The strengths of Manga2Animate lie in character preservation, content alignment, and cross-panel consistency, which matter most for this task, and participants in our user study also clearly preferred our results overall (Sec. 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 相比之下,StoryDifuncation和Story-Iter在动因特定美学衡量标准上的得分较高,而在manga忠心度(CIDS、PA、OCCM)方面则低得多,因为两者都不受原始字符和构成的限制,自由地从文字中生成图像。 这表明,单像美学和适应忠诚是不同的方面:一个美学预测器评估单个插图的吸引力而不考虑其是否与来源一致. Manga2Animate的优点在于人物保存、内容一致和跨小组的一致性,这一点对这项工作最为重要,我们用户研究的参与者也明确倾向于我们的总体结果(第4.6条)。

blocks.en: The two backends offer different cost trade-offs: FLUX.2 avoids external image-generation APIs but takes 1 h 59 min on local GPUs, while Gemini takes 20 min 2 s with 6 image-generation calls. Both are slower than StoryDiffusion and AnyStory but considerably cheaper than AniMaker, another multi-agent pipeline (8 h 9 min); users can choose a backend according to their compute resources and API budget.
blocks.zh: 两个后端提供不同的成本权衡: FLUX.2避免了外部图像生成API,但需要1h59分钟的本地GPU,而双子座则需要20分钟2s的图像生成呼叫. 两者都比StoryDifusion和AnyStory慢,但比另一多代理管道AniMaker(8h 9 min);用户可以根据他们的计算资源和API预算选择后端.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Ablation Results
blocks.zh: 附录D 额外结果

blocks.en: Sec. 4.7 compares clip-wise and script-wise script selection and reports the headline result; Table A2 gives the full metric breakdown. Clip-wise selection outperforms script-wise selection on I2VS, Subject Consistency, Background Consistency, and both aesthetic metrics, raising Waifu-v3 from 4.423 to 5.090 and Shadow-v2 from 0.473 to 0.518, while DD increases from 5.951 to 9.457. I2VB and Motion Smoothness are slightly lower than with script-wise selection (0.768 vs. 0.772 and 0.960 vs. 0.963), with both gaps within 0.004. We conjecture that clip-wise selection retains the more complete and specific clip descriptions among the candidates, enabling the video model to produce richer motion and visuals, whereas combining descriptions from different candidates may introduce slight variations in scene settings, causing the small drop in I2VB.
blocks.zh: 第4.7sec.比较剪辑和脚本脚本选择,并报告标题结果;表A2给出了完整的参数细分. 在I2VS,主题一致性,背景一致性以及两种审美度度量标准上,剪接式选择优于脚本选择,将Waifu-v3从4.423提高到5.090,Shadow-v2从0.473提高到0.518,而DD则从5.951提高到9.457. I2VB和Motion平滑度略低于脚本选择(0.768 vs.0.772和0.960 vs.0.963),两者的差距都在0.04以内. 我们推测,通过剪辑选择保留了候选人中更完整和具体的剪辑描述,使得视频模型能够产生更丰富的动作和视觉,而结合不同候选人的描述,可能会在场景设置中引入微小的变化,导致I2VB小幅下降.

blocks.en: Table A2: Ablation on script selection strategy. We compare Manga2Animate with clip-wise and script-wise selection. The full model selects the best clip description for each manga panel in a clip-wise manner and composes them into the final script, whereas script-wise selection directly picks one complete candidate script. All other models and settings are unchanged. Red cells denote the better result in each column.
blocks.zh: 表A2:对脚本选择策略的考虑. 我们比较Manga2Animate与剪辑和脚本选择。 完整模型以剪辑方式为每个漫画面板选择最佳剪辑描述,并将其编成最终脚本,而脚本选择则直接选择一个完整的候选脚本. 所有其他模型和设置都保持不变. 红细胞表示每列结果较好.

blocks.en: To examine the contribution of each feedback source in the refinement loop (Sec. 3.4 ), we withhold either the script-level or the storyboard-level feedback from the next-round Script Creator, while the reviewers still select the best script and storyboard in every round. All variants use the closed-source configuration, i.e., gemini-3.7-flash for all creator and reviewer agents and gemini-3.1-flash-image as the Storyboard Creator, and are evaluated at the storyboard level, where the feedback takes effect directly. Withholding a feedback source changes only the content of the Script Creator’s input, not the number of generation or review calls, so every variant has the same computational cost as the full pipeline (Table A1 ); we therefore omit the cost columns. As shown in Table A3 , removing either feedback source lowers CSD (0.605 to 0.597 and 0.588), CIDS (0.808 to 0.786 and 0.770), and PA (3.50 to 3.33 and 3.39) for the variants without script and without storyboard feedback, respectively. For OCCM, removing script feedback lowers the score from 72.2 to 70.8, whereas removing storyboard feedback yields a comparable 72.6. Removing storyboard feedback also lowers both aesthetic metrics more than removing script feedback (Shadow-v2: 0.249 vs. 0.334; Waifu-v3: 3.257 vs. 3.813), though the without-script-feedback variant slightly exceeds the full model on Waifu-v3 (3.813 vs. 3.798). These results indicate that script-level and storyboard-level feedback are complementary, and combining them mainly improves character identity and content alignment.
blocks.zh: 为了检查完善循环(Sec.3.4)中每个反馈源的贡献,我们保留了下一轮脚本创建者的脚本级或故事板级反馈,而审查者仍然在每个回合中选择最好的脚本和故事板. 所有变体都采用闭源配置,即所有创造者和审查者代理的Gemini-3.7-flash和Gemini-3.1-flash-image作为故事板创建者,并在故事板层面进行评价,反馈直接生效. 保留反馈源只会改变脚本创建者输入的内容,而不是生成或审查呼叫的次数,因此每个变体的计算成本与整个管道(表A1)相同;因此我们省略了成本栏。 如表A3所示,删除任何反馈源分别降低CSD(0.605至0.597和0.588)、CIDS(0.808至0.786和0.770)和PA(3.50至3.33和3.39),用于没有脚本和故事板反馈的变体。 对OCCM来说,删除脚本反馈将得分从72.2降至70.8,而删除故事板反馈则得出可比较的72.6. 删除故事板反馈也比去除脚本反馈更降低了两个审美度度量度(Shadow-v2:0.249 vs.0.334;Waifu-v3:3.257 vs.3.813),尽管无标注-feedback变体略高于Waifu-v3上的完整模型(3.813 vs. 3.798.). 这些结果表明脚本层面和故事板层面的反馈是互补的,将它们结合起来,主要可以改善人物身份和内容的一致.

blocks.en: Table A3: Ablation on dual-level feedback. The reviewers still select the best script and storyboard, but the feedback of one reviewer is withheld from the next-round Script Creator. All variants use the closed-source (Gemini) configuration. The Full Model row is the run reported in Table A1 . Cost is identical to the full pipeline and is therefore omitted. Red and orange mark the best and second-best results; higher is better.
blocks.zh: 表A3:双重级反馈的差异。 审查者仍然选择最好的脚本和故事板,但从下一轮的脚本创建者中不包含一名审查者的反馈. 所有变体都使用闭源(Gemini)配置. Full Model 行是表A1中报告的运行. 费用与整个管道相同,因此略去。 红色和橙色标记是最佳和次佳的结果;较高则更好。

blocks.en: Skipping the second-round feedback (w/o Refinement) or replacing the generated storyboard with the original manga panels (w/o Storyboard Gen.) both lower I2VS, I2VB, SC, and BC relative to the full model, and removing storyboard generation causes the larger drop, confirming that both stages contribute to the final video quality.
blocks.zh: 跳过第二轮反馈(w/o Fifinement),或用原漫画板(w/o Storyboard Gen.)取代生成的故事板,两者相对全模型都较低I2VS,I2VB,SC,以及BC,删除故事板生成导致更大的下降,证实两个阶段都有助于最终的视频质量.

blocks.en: Table A4: Ablation on the refinement loop and storyboard generation. w/o Refinement uses the first-pass script and storyboard directly, skipping the second-round feedback; w/o Storyboard Gen. keeps the same fully refined script but replaces the generated storyboard with a composite of the original manga panels. Removing either stage lowers I2VS, I2VB, SC, and BC relative to the full model, and removing storyboard generation causes the larger drop. Some variants score higher on MS or Shadow-v2, but lower on alignment, consistency, or DD. Red and orange mark the best and second-best results; higher is better.
blocks.zh: 表A4:关于精细循环和故事板生成的缩写. w/o Finalinement直接使用第一通道脚本和故事板,跳过第二回合的反馈;w/o Storyboard Gen. 保留相同的完全精细的脚本,但将生成的故事板替换为原漫画板的复合体. 移除任一阶段的I2VS,I2VB,SC,和BC相对全模型更低,删除故事板生成会导致更大的下降. 一些变体在MS或Shadow-v2上得分较高,但在对齐,一致性,或DD上得分较低. 红色和橙色标记是最佳和次佳的结果;较高则更好。

blocks.en: Manga2Animate supports both reference-conditioned and first-frame video generation. In the former, the video model receives the complete storyboard as a reference image and generates a full video. In the latter, each storyboard panel serves as the first frame of its corresponding clip, and the selected clips are assembled in order.
blocks.zh: Manga2Animate既支持有参考条件的视频生成,也支持第一帧的视频生成. 在前者中,视频模型接收完整的故事板作为参考图像,并生成完整的视频. 在后者中,每个故事板面板作为其相应剪辑的第一帧,所选剪辑按照顺序组装.

blocks.en: Table A5: Comparison of Video Generation Modes. Both modes use Gemini for storyboard generation and Seedance 2.0 for video generation. Bold indicates the higher value for each metric. Reference-conditioned generation gives better subject alignment, background consistency, and aesthetic scores, while first-frame generation gives better background alignment and slightly better subject consistency and motion smoothness.
blocks.zh: 表A5:视频生成模式比较. 两种模式都使用双子座进行故事板生成,种子2.0用于视频生成. 粗体表示每个度量值较高。 参考条件的生成使主题一致,背景一致,美学得分更好,而第一种帧生成则使背景一致更好,主题一致和运动平滑略好.

blocks.en: As shown in Table A5 , reference-conditioned mode obtains higher I2VS, BC, Shadow-v2, and Waifu-v3 scores, while first-frame mode obtains higher I2VB and slightly higher SC and MS scores. The results demonstrate that the pipeline can also operate with first-frame video generation when full-storyboard reference conditioning is unavailable. We use reference-conditioned mode for the main results.
blocks.zh: 如表A5所示,参考条件模式获得更高的I2VS,BC,Shadow-v2和Waifu-v3分数,而第一帧模式获得更高的I2VB和略高的SC和MS分数. 结果显示,当没有全层板参考条件时,管道也可以使用第一级视频生成。 我们对主要结果采用参照条件模式。

blocks.en: Appendix E Baseline Adaptation
blocks.zh: 附录E 基线适应

blocks.en: StoryDiffusion’s official multi-character mechanism takes only plain-text, per-shot prompts that tag which characters appear, with no interface for image-conditioned identity. To keep the comparison fair, we take the same final best script produced by Manga2Animate’s own creator-reviewer refinement (Sec. 3.4 ) and reformat character descriptions and per-shot scene/action text into the per-shot prompts its official multi-character mechanism requires. Because StoryDiffusion has no reference-image input, the manga-cropped character images used elsewhere in our evaluation do not apply here; identity relies purely on text description, a limitation of the method when processing image information. Each story yields 6 panels, composed into the same 3 × 2 3\times 2 grid as the other backends for evaluation.
blocks.zh: StoryDifusion的官方多特征机制只使用纯文本,每发提示显示字符的标记,没有图像条件化身份的接口. 为了保持比较的公平,我们将Manga2Animate自己的创作者-审查者(Sec. 3.4)制作的最后最佳剧本以及重塑人物描述和每张照片的场景/行动文字,作为每张照片的提示,它的官方多特征机制需要。 因为StoryDifmusion没有参考图像输入,所以我们评价中其他地方使用的漫畫字符影像在此不适用;身份完全依赖于文字描述,这是处理图像信息时方法的限制. 每个故事产生6个面板,由3×2 3\times 2格组成,与其他评价后端相同.

blocks.en: Story-Iter generates a sequence of story images from ordered text prompts and maintains cross-image consistency through Global Reference Cross-Attention (GRCA) over previously generated results. To unify the story content, we convert the final refined script of Manga2Animate (Sec. 3.4 ) into six prompts ordered by manga panel, preserving the characters, interactions, scenes, actions, and camera descriptions. Generation follows the official settings with the comic style. Since Story-Iter does not accept external character reference images, we do not add an identity-control module. The six generated images are composed into a 3 × 2 3\times 2 grid in order and scored with MangaEval.
blocks.zh: Story-Iter从订购的文本提示中生成一系列故事图像,并通过全球参考交叉观察(GRCA)在以往生成的结果上保持跨图像的一致性. 为了统一故事内容,我们把Manga2Animate(第3.4节)的最终精细剧本转换成6个由manga面板订购的提示,保留人物,互动,场景,动作和相机描述. 世代遵循带有漫画风格的官方设置. 由于Story-Iter不接受外部字符参考图像,我们不添加身份控制模块. 六个生成的图像按照顺序组成一个3×2 3\times 2网格,并和MangaEval打分.

blocks.en: AnyStory supports personalized story image generation with character reference images. To unify the story content, we convert the final refined script of Manga2Animate (Sec. 3.4 ) into the structured script required by AnyStory, preserving the characters, scenes, actions, interactions, and camera descriptions of the six panels, and we use the same manga-cropped character images as character references. All other stages follow the official AnyStory implementation, without adding the Storyboard Creator or Reviewer of Manga2Animate. The six generated images are composed into a 3 × 2 3\times 2 grid in panel order and scored with MangaEval.
blocks.zh: AnyStory支持个性化的故事图像生成与人物参考图像. 为了统一故事内容,我们将Manga2Animate(Sec. 3.4)的最终精细剧本转换为AnyStory所要求的结构化剧本,保留六面板的人物,场景,动作,互动,和相机描述,我们使用相同的manga-croped字符图像作为人物参考. 所有其他阶段都跟随AnyStory正式执行,而未加入Manga2Animate的故事板创建者或评论者. 这六张生成的图像按照面板顺序组成了3×2 3\times 2格,并和MangaEval打分.

blocks.en: AniMaker natively takes a plain-text story and self-generates both the script (via an LLM) and the character portrait (via Hunyuan3D ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) ). To compare video-generation ability rather than manga-understanding ability, we replace only these two front-end stages: the script is converted from Manga2Animate’s own final, refined script (Sec. 3.4 ) into AniMaker’s native script.json format, and the character portrait is replaced with the same manga-cropped reference image used by our pipeline. All remaining stages (environment-image generation, scene-prompt synthesis, MCTS-based candidate clip generation and selection, narration, and final assembly) retain AniMaker’s original implementation and default hyperparameters, and outputs are scored under the same MangaEval protocol as all baselines.
blocks.zh: AniMaker本土取了一个纯文字故事,并自创了剧本(通过LLM)和人物肖像(通过Hunyuan3D(赵等人,2025年)). 为了比较视频生成能力而不是漫画理解能力,我们只取代这两个前端阶段:脚本由Manga2Animate自己的最终精细脚本(Sec. 3.4)转换成AniMaker的本土脚本.json格式,角色肖像被替换为我们输油管使用的相同的漫画刻版参考图像. 所有剩余的阶段(环境-图像生成、场景-即时合成、基于MCTS的候选剪辑生成和选择、叙述和最终组装)都保留了AniMaker的最初执行和默认的超参数,并且输出值与所有基线都在同一MangaEval协议下得分。

blocks.en: StoryMem generates multi-shot videos shot by shot from a structured story script and a visual memory. To unify the story content, we convert the final refined script of Manga2Animate (Sec. 3.4 ) into the StoryMem format, preserving the characters, actions, scenes, and camera descriptions, and adopt the reference-initialized M2V setting, which uses the six manga panels as the initial visual references. Video generation uses the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) backbone with the corresponding StoryMem LoRA checkpoint, and the visual-memory update and shot-by-shot generation follow the official settings. We keep its original mechanism without adding the storyboard, Video Reviewer, or candidate selection of Manga2Animate, and the generated shots are concatenated in script order for evaluation.
blocks.zh: StoryMem从结构化的故事剧本和视觉记忆中以镜头方式生成多镜头视频. 为了统一故事内容,我们将Manga2Animate(Sec. 3.4)的最终精细剧本转换为StoryMem格式,保留人物,动作,场景,和相机描述,并采用参考初始化的M2V设定,该设定使用6个manga面板作为最初的视觉参考. 视频生成使用Wan2.2-I2V-A14B(Wan et al.,2025)骨干,并设有相应的StoryMem LoRA检查站,视觉记忆更新和逐弹生成遵循官方设置. 我们保留其原始机制,不添加故事板,视频评论员,或选用Manga2Animate,生成的镜头按剧本排列,以便评价.

blocks.en: ViMax supports a screenplay as input and automatically performs storyboarding, shot planning, character image generation, and video clip generation. To prevent it from rewriting the story from a short concept, we use its Script2Video workflow and convert the final refined script of Manga2Animate (Sec. 3.4 ) into a screenplay input that preserves the characters, scenes, actions, dialogue, camera descriptions, and narrative order. The manga-cropped character images serve as ViMax’s character references to maintain appearance consistency. We use gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3.1-flash-image as the language and image generation models, and Seedance 2.0 (or Veo 3.1 Fast) as the video generation model through external APIs. All other storyboard, shot-planning, and video-generation stages follow the original Script2Video pipeline of ViMax, without adding the storyboard or reviewer modules of Manga2Animate.
blocks.zh: ViMax支持一个剧本作为输入,并自动进行故事板,拍摄规划,人物图像生成,以及视频剪辑生成. 为了防止它从一个短的概念中重写故事,我们使用它的Script2Video工作流程,并将Manga2Animate(Sec. 3.4)的最终精细剧本转换为剧本输入,保留人物,场景,动作,对话,镜头描述,以及叙事顺序. manga-croped字符图像作为维马克斯的字符参考,以保持外观的一致性. 我们使用Gemini-3.6-flash和Gemini-3.1-flash-image作为语言和图像生成模型,而种子2.0(或Veo 3.1 Fast)通过外部API作为视频生成模型. 所有其他的故事板,镜头规划,和视频生成阶段都遵循了ViMax的原始Script2Video管道,而没有加入Manga2Animate的故事板或评论员模块.

blocks.zh: 我们提供了表A7和A7概述的衡量标准的全部定义。

blocks.en: Visual Consistency is measured by CSD and CIDS, each reporting the average of a cross score (similarity between generated panels and the character reference images) and a self score (similarity among generated panels). CSD ( Somepalli et al., 2024 ) uses CSD-CLIP ViT-L style features and is unmodified. CIDS detects characters in the generated panels with GroundingDINO ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , assigns them to reference characters by Hungarian matching ( Kuhn, 1955 ) , and compares identity features; we replace the original CLIP at 224px with SigLIP (so400m) at 384px, and the cross score is computed over successfully matched character crops. Content Alignment is measured by PA and OCCM. PA uses GPT-4.1 to score each panel on scene, character action, and camera, and each character crop on single-character action, on a 0–4 scale; each item is sampled 5 times at temperature 1.0 and averaged, and PA is the average over the four aspects. The scoring reference is the per-panel text converted from the refined script, which is shared by all script-conditioned methods. OCCM = 100 ⋅ exp ⁡ ( − | D − E | ϵ + max ⁡ ( E , 1 ) ) \mathrm{OCCM}=100\cdot\exp\!\left(-\frac{|D-E|}{\epsilon+\max(E,1)}\right) , where D D is the number of characters GroundingDINO detects in the generated panel and E E is the expected count, now obtained by applying the same detector to the source manga panel rather than taken from the script’s cast list. Aesthetic Quality is measured by two anime-specific models: Aesthetic Shadow v2 (a 1.1B-parameter high-/low-quality ViT classifier, score = P ⁡ ( high quality ) =P(\text{high quality}) ) and Waifu-Scorer v3 (CLIP ViT-L/14 features with an MLP regression head, output in [ 0 , 10 ] [0,10] ), averaged over the six generated panels. Computational Cost is the average number of VLM/LLM calls, image-generation calls, and wall-clock time per story.
blocks.zh: 视觉一致性由CSD和CIDS测量,每个都报告一个交叉分数的平均值(生成的面板和字符参考图像之间的相同)和一个自我分数(生成的面板之间的相同). CSD(Somepalli等人,2024年)使用CSD-CLIP ViT-L风格特征,没有修改. CIDS在生成的面板中检测到带有GroundingDINO(Liu et al., 2024b)的字符,通过匈牙利匹配(Kuhn, 1955)来指定它们为参考字符,并比较身份特征;我们用384px的SigLIP(so400m)取代了224px的原始CLIP,交叉比分是计算成功匹配的字符作物. 内容一致由巴勒斯坦权力机构和OCCM衡量。 PA使用GPT-4.1在现场,人物动作和相机上对每个面板进行评分,每个字符作物在单字符动作上进行0–4尺度的评分;每件物品在温度1.0和平均值下进行5次抽样,PA是四个方面的平均值. 评分参考是从精制的脚本中转换出来的每板块文字,由所有脚本条件化的方法共享. OCCM = 100 ⋅  ex  ex  ex ⁡ ⁡ (− | D | E | ε ε ⁡ ⁡ ⁡ ⁡ ⁡ (E, 1))\mathrm{OCCM }= 100\cdot\exp\!\左(-\frac{|D-E|}{\epsilon+\max(E,1)}\ }\),其中D是生成面板中的字符GroundingDINO探测器数量,EE是预期的计数,现在通过将同一探测器应用到源头漫画面板而不是从脚本的投影列表中取出. 美学质量通过两种特定动量模型进行测量: 审美阴影 v2(一个1.1B参数高/低质量) ViT分类器,分数=PQQ(高品质)=P(\text{高品质})和Waifu-Scorer v3(CLIP ViT-L/14特性带有MLP回归头,输出在[0,10] [0,10]),平均超过六个生成的面板. 计算成本是每个故事的VLM/LLM调用,图像生成调用和墙钟时间的平均数量.

blocks.en: Each video is split into six segments corresponding to the six manga panels, and metrics are computed per segment and averaged. Manga Alignment is measured by I2VS and I2VB. I2VS measures the subject similarity between the frames of each segment and the corresponding character reference image using VBench++’s original formula, which combines the maximum similarity to the reference with the mean and minimum similarity between consecutive frames, with its DINO ViT-B/16 backbone replaced by DINOv3 ViT-B/16; segments without characters are excluded. I2VB measures the background similarity between the frames of each segment and the corresponding source manga panel using DreamSim ( Fu et al., 2023 ) features, with both formula and backbone unmodified. Video Quality is measured by Subject Consistency and Background Consistency (DINO- and CLIP-based frame-to-first-frame and frame-to-previous-frame similarity, respectively, both unmodified VBench++ metrics), Motion Smoothness (an unmodified VBench++ metric based on AMT frame interpolation ( Li et al., 2023 ) ), and Dynamic Degree. We change DD from VBench++’s binary decision based on the top-5% RAFT ( Teed & Deng, 2020 ) flow magnitudes into a continuous motion-magnitude score: each video is resampled to about 8 fps, RAFT computes optical flow between consecutive frames at the native resolution, and the flow magnitude is averaged over all pixels and frame pairs and normalized by 256 / min ⁡ ( H , W ) 256/\min(H,W) . DD measures motion magnitude rather than motion correctness. Aesthetic Quality reuses Aesthetic Shadow v2 and Waifu-Scorer v3 from the storyboard level, applied to every frame per video and averaged. Computational Cost is the end-to-end average number of VLM calls, generation calls, and wall-clock time per story.
blocks.zh: 每段录像分为6个部分,与6个漫画面板相对应,每段计算和平均衡量尺度。 漫游对齐由I2VS和I2VB测量. I2VS使用VBench++’s的原始公式测量每个片段的帧和相应的字符参考图像之间的主题相似性,将与引用的最大相似性与连续帧之间的平均值和最小相似性结合起来,其DINO VIT-B/16主干线被DINov3 VIT-B/16所取代;没有字符的片段被排除在外. I2VB使用DreamSim(Fu等人,2023年)特性测量每个段的帧和相应的源漫游面板之间的背景相似性,其公式和主干线都没有修改. 视频质量通过主题一致性和背景一致性(基于DINO-和CLIP的帧对第一帧和帧对前帧的相似性分别是未经修改的V Bench++ 度量衡),运动平滑度(一个基于AMT帧内插值(Li等人,2023年)的未经修改的V Bench+++ 度量衡),动态度度测量. 我们根据最高5%的RAFT(Teed & Deng, 2020年)的流量分数,将DD从V Bench ++’s二进制决定改为连续运动放大分数:每段视频被复制到大约8英尺,RAFT在原生分辨率下计算连续帧之间的光学流量,所有像素和帧对的流量分数平均,并正常化为256/min(H,W)256/\min(H,W). DD度量运动量级而非运动正确性. 审美质量再利用 审美阴影 v2和来自故事板层的Waifu-Scorer v3,适用于每段视频的每个帧并平均. 计算成本(Computingal Cost)是每个故事的VLM呼叫,一代呼叫,以及墙钟时间的端到端平均次数.

blocks.en: All reviewers are prompted to first describe each candidate with respect to every criterion before reaching a verdict, and to output a structured JSON object containing per-criterion winners or scores, an overall winner, and improvement suggestions for the winner. The suggestions include only criteria on which the winner still shows observable weaknesses and serve as the feedback passed to the next refinement round. The full prompts are listed in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 促使所有审查人员首先根据每项标准描述每个候选人,然后作出判决,并输出一个结构化的JSON对象,其中包含每个标准得分者,一个总得分者,以及对得分者提出的改进建议. 这些建议只包括赢家仍然表现出明显弱点的标准,并作为反馈传递给下一轮完善工作。 完整提示列于附录H。

blocks.en: Inputs: the ordered manga panels, the character reference image(s), and the character descriptions of all N s N_{s} candidate scripts. Criteria (one winner each, one point per win): (1) clothing match, (2) physical appearance accuracy, including facial features, hairstyle, and body proportions, (3) color accuracy with respect to the character reference image, and (4) left/right specificity of asymmetric features such as scars, hair parts, and accessories. The manga panels serve as the ground truth except for colors, which follow the reference image. Ties in total score are broken in the priority order (2) > > (1) > > (4) > > (3).
blocks.zh: 输入:命令的漫画面板,字符参考图像,以及所有Ns NQQS}候选脚本的字符描述. 标准(每个胜者一个,每个胜者一个分): (1)服装匹配, (2)外观精度,包括面部特征,发型,和身体比例,(3)角色参考图像的颜色精度,(4)伤疤,毛部和附件等不对称特征的左/右特异性. 漫画板作为地面真理,除了颜色外,它们跟随参考图像. 总分中的连线在优先级(2) > >中被打破. (1) > > > > (四) > > > > > > > (3)  (3).

blocks.en: Inputs: one manga panel, the character descriptions (used only to identify characters), and the N s N_{s} candidate descriptions of that panel. Criteria (one winner each): (1) small objects associated with each character, penalizing both missing and hallucinated objects, (2) facial expressions and emotions, (3) background accuracy, (4) object placement and orientation, (5) character body orientation and spatial relationships, and (6) dialogue speaker assignment. Ties are broken in the priority order (6) > > (5) > > (4) > > (2) > > (1) > > (3). The reviewer runs independently for each panel position, and the winning descriptions are reassembled into the final script (Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 输入:一个漫画面板,字符描述(仅用于识别字符),以及该面板的Ns N_{s}候选人描述. 标准(每个胜者一个): (1)与每个角色相关的小物体,惩罚缺失和幻觉物体,(2)面部表情和情感,(3)背景精度,(4)物体放置和定向,(5)人物身体定向和空间关系,(6)对话演讲者分配. 按优先级排列的绑断(6) > > > (5) > > > > 翻译: (四) > > > > > > > (2) > > > > > 翻译: (1) > > > > (3)  (3). 审查者为每个面板位置独立运行,获胜的描述重新组合成最终脚本(图4).

blocks.en: Inputs: the six manga panels, the character reference image(s), two candidate storyboards A and B, and the script used to generate them. Thirteen criteria, one point each: (1) character identity preservation, (2) overall art-style consistency with the manga, (3) color presence (not primarily black-and-white), (4) consistent panel size in the 3 × 2 3\times 2 layout, (5) only existing characters, (6) narrative order consistency, (7) script alignment, (8) rich background, (9) background consistency across panels, (10) character and object position consistency across panels, (11) panel-internal object layout match with the manga, (12) no dialogue boxes or captions, and (13) left/right consistency of asymmetric character features. Criteria (3), (4), (5), (6), and (12) are judged pass/fail for each storyboard independently, so both storyboards may receive the point; the others are comparative. The storyboard with the higher total wins, and remaining ties are broken by a fixed criterion priority order. From the second round onward, a variant of the prompt compares each new candidate with the previous best storyboard, each judged against the script it was generated from.
blocks.zh: 输入:六张漫画面板,人物参考图像,两个候选的故事板A和B,以及用来生成的脚本. 13条标准,每条标准各1点:(1)人物身份保存,(2)整体艺术风格与漫画一致,(3)色彩存在(不主要是黑白两色),(4)3×2 3\times 2布局一致的面板大小,(5)只有现有字符,(6)叙事顺序一致,(7)脚本对齐,(8)丰富背景,(9)各面板的背景一致,(10)面板和对象位置一致,(11)面板内部对象布局与漫画一致,(12)没有对话框或标题,以及(13)不对称字符特征的左/右一致性. 标准(3),(4),(5),(6),和(12)每个故事板被独立判断通过/失败,因此两个故事板都可能得到点;其他则比较. 故事板的总胜率较高,剩下的关系被固定的标准优先级顺序打破. 从第二轮开始,提示的变体将每个新候选人与之前最好的故事板进行对比,每个角色根据它产生的剧本来判断.

blocks.en: Inputs: the source manga panel, the character references for that panel (possibly none), the corresponding script clip, and one candidate panel. Each candidate is scored independently on a 0–4 scale for (1) manga/script follow, covering action, pose, composition, and framing (the primary criterion), (2) character identity consistency, (3) art style and colorization quality, penalizing black-and-white line art, screentone residue, and speech bubbles, and (4) background and environment fidelity. The candidate with the highest total is kept, with ties broken by criterion (1).
blocks.zh: 输入:源漫画面板,该面板的字符引用(可能没有),相应的脚本剪辑,以及一个候选面板. 每个候选人在0–4级中独立得分:(1) 漫画/书写随从,涵盖动作、姿势、组成和框架(主要标准)、(2) 性格特征一致性、(3) 艺术风格和色彩化质量、惩罚黑白线条艺术、屏风残片和语音泡沫以及(4) 背景和环境忠贞。 候选人总数最高,但被标准(1)打破。

blocks.en: Inputs: the generation prompt and two candidate videos A and B, plus the previously selected clip for every clip after the first in the first-frame mode. For the first clip, and in the reference-conditioned mode, the criteria and weights are visual realism (0.35), physical commonsense (0.30), and video-prompt alignment (0.35), where alignment also checks left/right directional correctness. For subsequent clips in the first-frame mode, these weights become 0.2 each, and coherency with the previous clip is added with a weight of 0.4. Each criterion is scored 1 (A wins), 0 (B wins), or 0.5 (tie), and a penalty of 0.5 is subtracted for violating hard constraints, such as sudden appearance or disappearance of main objects, unnecessary scene transitions, or unnaturally fast or slow motion. If the weighted scores differ by less than 0.05, the two candidates are judged comparable and the first candidate is kept.
blocks.zh: 输入:生成即时和两个候选视频A和B,加上先前选用的第一帧模式后每段剪辑的剪辑. 对于第一个片段,以及在参考条件模式下,标准和权重是视觉现实主义(0.35),物理常识(0.30),视频即时对齐(0.35),其中对齐还检查左/右方向正确性. 对于第一帧模式中后续的片段,这些重量变为每段0.2,与之前的片段的一致性增加0.4的重量. 每个标准得分1(A胜),0(B胜),或0.5(tie),违反硬约束,如主体突然出现或消失,不必要的场景过渡,或非自然快慢动作,则减0.5的处罚. 如果加权分数相差小于0.05,则判定两名候选人具有可比性,并保留第一名候选人。
